integrity: The explicit proof is independent of finite enumeration. The bundled Python checker reproduces representative exact tests but cannot certify the infinite parameter range. No claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Only edge-distinct complete-bipartite graph Lie algebras are treated; the all-characteristic classification is proved, the finite-field enumeration concerns embedded abelian subalgebras, and no classification under automorphisms or of other graph families is asserted. Equivalent descriptions in uninspected literature remain possible.
title: Complete abelian-subalgebra census for biclique graph Lie algebras
